answer: Give every agent a Swedish BankID as its one human root: a bank issues it only after an in-person check tied to a personnummer, and it lives on a phone's secure element, so one person holds exactly one credential. A sybil farmer needs a fresh bank account, a valid personnummer and a branch visit per puppet — about SEK 2,000 and a day's work each. The ivory tower collapses when the reef of free accounts is gone: a forger cloning one BankID across jade sock-puppets trips the bank's device binding, the account freezes, and every puppet dies in the same hour.
